data.name: The Structureworld: Myths of Skull Island
data.detailed_description:
After a US Navy ship disappears somewhere off the coast of East Australia, while unmarked ships have been spotted for months in that area, special US military personnel have been tasked with finding any signs of the Navy ship while keeping a lookout for the unmarked ships.

While searching, an area right in the middle between East Australia and Mexico is discovered to have constant storms and thick fog, which might have caused the Navy ship to disappear.

After a few days of preparation, you and your soldiers fly into the fog in military helicopters for a scouting operation when something beneath the waves starts taking down the helicopters one by one.

After crashing onto the island that brings only death and despair, you will have to survive by exploring the many wreckages along the coastline, setting up small camps, and trying to find any survivors while waiting for a possible rescue.

All of this will lead to the realization that you weren't looking for a US Navy ship to begin with....

This single-player hardcore survival and shooter game will launch in early access, starting with an introduction level,

2 possible base location levels where you can choose to build your camp, and 2 maps to enter, survive, fight, gather resources in, and progress the story.

Map names:

  • Coastal Crashsite

  • The wreckage

*Game will launch in early access(end 2026) to find any new bugs and gather feedback, but will launch in a complete, playable state with most of the gameplay loops and elements present.

After launch bug fixes, balancing and new maps will roll out.

The game will also be released with a gore-censor option for youtube(to prevent demonetization).

data.short_description: Survive in this epic semi-open world Survival/Shooter Game on a new interpretation of Skull Island filled with your biggest nightmares! Start building your Base of Operations in one of the two buidable area's, enter different biomes of the island to scout, gather resources and find a way to escape!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700 CPU @ 3.40GHz 3.41 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Just like Minecraft, Java & OpenGL is needed to run
